description:
The extraction recipe uses mean field probability 0.10, fills enclosed holes strictly smaller than 100 m² and requires at least 900 m². Independent crop filtering evaluates parcels from 900 to 5,000,000 m² and removes those with less than 5% overlap with the native 2017/2020/2024 Impact Observatory crop union; unknown or incomplete observations and parcels outside those size bounds are retained by this filter. The embedded processing description below also records downstream vector cleanup, including its separate 20 m² hole rule. These stages have different purposes and thresholds.

Predicted agricultural field boundaries for 2025: 225,542,717 parcels (7,191,940 km² of field area) in 60 per-UTM-zone GeoParquet files, 100.3 GiB total. Explore the year on the [interactive map](https://research.taylorgeospatial.org/global-ftw-2e/web/#year=2025), walk its metadata in the [Portolan browser](https://browser.portolan-sdi.org/#/external/data.source.coop/ftw/global-data-2e/vector/2025/collection.json), or download the files from [Source Cooperative](https://source.coop/ftw/global-data-2e). Part of [Fields of the World](https://fieldsofthe.world) — agricultural field boundaries delineated from Sentinel-2 imagery.

**How this was made.** Fields of The World (FTW) model on Sentinel-2 quarterly cloudless mosaics (CDSE sentinel-2-global-mosaics, 2025 Q1-Q4, 4 quarters x B04/B03/B02/B08), 2.5 m field/boundary probabilities, BoundaryVote instance post-processing (nbg-pb-h0.01-t0.5+R10+F10+G2+H100lt+A900+q1), 5 m coverage simplification, parcels > 5 km2 removed, parcels at least 70% Impact Observatory io-lulc 2024 water (inland water, aquaculture ponds, salt pans) removed, parcels with less than 50% of their area on OpenStreetMap land polygons (sea) removed, parcels and parts under 900 m2 removed, interior holes under 20 m2 filled. Attributes are for filtering. Source imagery: the [TGE Labs Sentinel-2 quarterly cloudless mosaics](https://source.coop/tge-labs/sentinel-2-quarterly-cloudless-mosaics/) (CDSE mirror). The full pipeline, from mosaic download to this file, is documented in [pipeline/README.md](https://github.com/fieldsoftheworld/ftw-global-data-catalog/blob/main/pipeline/README.md).

The schema follows [fiboa 0.3.0](https://fiboa.org/specification/v0.3.0/schema.yaml) and [vecorel 0.1.0](https://vecorel.org/specification/v0.1.0/schema.yaml): columns id, collection, geometry, bbox, metrics:area, metrics:perimeter, score, determination:datetime, determination:method — see `table:columns` for definitions.

**Reading all 60 partitions at once.** The glob is `s3://ftw/global-data-2e/vector/2025/zone=*/utm*.parquet` (`partition:glob`), served anonymously by the [Source Cooperative data proxy](https://docs.source.coop/data-proxy) at endpoint `data.source.coop` — same keys as the HTTPS URLs, no credentials and no region. Expanding a wildcard needs a listing, which plain HTTPS does not offer, so the `s3://` form is the one to paste into DuckDB, GDAL or fsspec; `storage:schemes` carries the endpoint and the path-style setting. In DuckDB: `CREATE SECRET (TYPE s3, PROVIDER config, ENDPOINT 'data.source.coop', URL_STYLE 'path');` then `SELECT zone, count(*) FROM read_parquet('s3://ftw/global-data-2e/vector/2025/zone=*/utm*.parquet', hive_partitioning=1) GROUP BY zone;` — `hive_partitioning=1` is what makes `zone` a column. One partition at a time is a plain HTTPS read of `https://data.source.coop/ftw/global-data-2e/vector/2025/zone=NN/utmNN.parquet`, and each partition is an item of this collection with its own size and checksum.

source-coop-s3.title: Source Cooperative data proxy (S3-compatible, anonymous)
source-coop-s3.description: Anonymous read and anonymous listing, no credentials and no region needed; the keys match the public HTTPS URLs one for one. Clients must override the endpoint and address it path-style, which is what this platform URL without a `{bucket}` placeholder asks for: in DuckDB `CREATE SECRET (TYPE s3, PROVIDER config, ENDPOINT 'data.source.coop', URL_STYLE 'path');`, in GDAL `AWS_S3_ENDPOINT=data.source.coop` with `AWS_VIRTUAL_HOSTING=FALSE` and `AWS_NO_SIGN_REQUEST=YES`, and for the AWS CLI `--endpoint-url https://data.source.coop --no-sign-request`. The proxy is in beta; a bulk pull may be faster straight from the underlying bucket, `s3://us-west-2.opendata.source.coop/ftw/global-data-2e/`, which holds the same objects under the same keys.
